build_semantic_seg_dataset: build a semantic segmentation dataset by subclassing BaseSegDataset and overriding METAINFO with class names
create_label_map: create a label mapping from old to new class labels using BaseSegDataset.get_label_map with new class names
load_data_list: load image and segmentation map paths from an annotation file or directory using BaseSegDataset.load_data_list
update_palette: update or generate a color palette for segmentation classes using BaseSegDataset._update_palette method
review_BaseSegDataset: review the BaseSegDataset class and its initialization parameters for custom semantic segmentation dataset configuration
